title: Contract tranche scheduler proposal - capacity smoothing & penalty windows
body:
SUMMARY:
This working sheet proposes a per-contract tranche scheduler that enforces regional smoothing and explicit burst windows to reduce contention across Dedicated tenants. The core idea: convert large, multi-month reservation commitments into deterministic slices and prioritized burst windows, with soft penalties for exceeding burst allocations. The sheet below is a simulation and initial recommended rollout for the November 2026 customer tranche onboarding wave.

ASSUMPTIONS:
- Fleet mix: 60% A100 (40GB), 40% H100 (80GB) across NA/EU/APAC.
- We target 75% long-term utilization on guaranteed slabs and allow up to 20% burst above guaranteed within defined windows.
- Burst penalties are soft for first 3 occurrences (warning + throttling), escalated financial fallback on repeat breaches.
- Time zones: NA = PST, EU = CET, APAC = SGT.
- All contracts have explicit Guaranteed GPUs and Option Burst GPUs in their SLA.

SIMULATED CONTRACT TRANCHE TABLE (columns separated by |):
ContractID | Customer | Region | GPU-SKU | Guaranteed-GPUs | Burst-Option-GPUs | Peak-Window (local) | Utilization-target (%) | Recent-7d-util (%) | Suggested-phasing | Penalty-band
CT-2026-411 | NovaMaps | NA | A100 | 48 | 12 | Mon-Fri 09:00-18:00 PST | 75 | 82 | Phase1: 48 immediate; Phase2: +12 after 3mo | Band A (warning -> throttle)
CT-2026-415 | HelixHealth | EU | H100 | 80 | 16 | Tue-Thu 08:00-20:00 CET | 75 | 68 | Phase1: ramp 40/80 over 4w; reserve burst windows Tue/Thu | Band B (warning -> cost-adjust)
CT-2026-419 | RetailLoop | NA | A100 | 24 | 8 | Fri-Sun 00:00-06:00 PST | 60 | 55 | Phase1: 24; Phase2: +8 seasonal (Q4) | Band C (monitor)
CT-2026-424 | AtlasAI | APAC | H100 | 120 | 24 | Mon-Fri 10:00-16:00 SGT | 80 | 86 | Phase1: 60; Phase2: add 60 in 2 months | Band A (immediate throttle on breach)
CT-2026-430 | CivicGov | EU | A100 | 16 | 4 | Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00 CET | 70 | 40 | Phase1: delayed start (30d) due to infra onboarding | Band D (grace)

SIMULATION SCENARIOS (30-day rolling windows):
Scenario A - Baseline: enforce Guaranteed-GPUs only, no burst allowed.
  - Avg cluster utilization (NA pool): 71%
  - Incidence: 12% of customers report queue/backpressure events during NA peak.
Scenario B - Burst windows allowed (policy proposed): 20% burst reserved in defined windows; soft penalties first 3x.
  - Avg cluster utilization (NA pool): 78%
  - Incidence: queue events reduced to 4%; bursts concentrated and predictable.
Scenario C - Aggressive smoothing: staggered phase-ins across contracts with 50% initial guarantees, auto-escalation of allocation for high-quality customers.
  - Avg cluster utilization (NA pool): 74%
  - Incidence: queue events 2%, but increased scheduling complexity and longer phasing timeline.

QUANT ECONOMIC MODEL (high level, per GPU-month):
- A100 marginal cost (provisioned) = $1,200 / GPU-month
- H100 marginal cost (provisioned) = $2,200 / GPU-month
- Soft burst cost credit = 0.45x marginal for first 3 bursts (to encourage predictable bursting)
- Repeat-breach surcharge = 1.5x marginal for additional months until contract rebalanced
Example: AtlasAI burst 24 H100 during one month -> accounting hit = 24 * 2,200 * 0.45 = $23,760 (soft burst) unless repeated -> then 24 * 2,200 * 1.5 = $79,200

RECOMMENDED SCHEDULER RULES (prototype):
- Enforce Guaranteed-GPUs at all times; queue requests beyond guaranteed into per-contract burst-rate limiter.
- Allow time-windowed burst capacity (config per contract) with token bucket: burst-burst_rate tokens per 24h window.
- Region affinity: prefer routing within the contract's primary region; cross-region spill allowed only after local burst exhausted and with lower priority.
- Phased-onboarding: large contracts (>64 GPUs) must accept 2-stage onboarding by default.
- Monitoring & alerts: create per-contract SLOs (latency/cost) and automated billing events tied to penalty bands.

OPERATIONAL CHECKLIST (for rollout):
- [ ] Finalize penalty band wording with legal (assigned: Lena).
- [ ] Build scheduler feature flag (assigned: Diego) - target canary NA pool first.
- [ ] Create per-contract dashboard template in Console (assigned: Samir).
- [ ] Prepare customer comms for Nov tranche (template drafted).
- [ ] Simulate 30-day run with synthetic traces (next: run INFRA-2147).

OPEN QUESTIONS / DECISIONS NEEDED:
- How aggressive should financial penalties be versus throttling? (ops vs sales tradeoff).
- Acceptable cross-region spill limits for enterprise customers with geo-data constraints.
- Auto-rebalancing frequency (monthly vs quarterly) when utilization drifts >15%.

NEXT STEPS:
1) Review and sign-off on penalty bands by 2026-11-18.
2) Diego to submit PR for scheduler token-bucket implementation by 2026-11-24.
3) Run canary with NovaMaps and RetailLoop in NA pool starting 2026-12-01 for 2 weeks.
4) Post-canary: adopt conservative rollout to rest of Nov tranche in Jan 2027.

NOTES / LINKS:
- Reference: existing reservation policy (confluence://infra/contract-slicing) and INFRA-2147 ticket.
- Quick test harness: scripts/contract-sim/30d-runner (see linked PR).

FEEDBACK LOG (inline comments expected):

- Diego: add estimated scheduler cpu/memory cost impact per pool.
- Samir: propose dashboard metrics (daily-burst-usage, burst-events, unmet-guarantee-count).

END OF SHEET

(Notes-to-self: rough numbers, will re-run GPU-cost assumptions with updated provider invoices next week. This doc intentionally mixes narrative and tabular rows for quick iteration.)
